location: Fetch, determine the same-site mode, steps 2 and 3

en.title: Fetch: the Lax exception for cross-site navigations cannot be reached
en.summary: The check for a cross-site navigation initiator runs before the check for a top-level GET document. A cross-site link therefore never reaches the step meant for it, and that step catches same-site navigations instead. By the text, a Lax cookie is not sent on a cross-site link and a Strict cookie is not sent on a same-origin link.
en.impact: A link from site a to site b, GET: by the text the SameSite=Lax cookie is not sent; Chromium 156, Firefox 157 and WebKit 27.2 send it. A same-origin link, GET: by the text the SameSite=Strict cookie is not sent; all three send it.
en.correction: Decide cross-site GET navigations before the general cross-site case, and give other navigations the full mode.

quotes.locator: Fetch, determine the same-site mode, step 2
quotes.text: If request's top-level navigation initiator origin is not null and is not same site with request's URL's origin, then return "unset-or-less".

quotes.locator: Fetch, determine the same-site mode, step 3
quotes.text: If request's method is "GET" and request's destination is "document", then return "lax-or-less".
